text.en:
Secretary of Tourism. - The Secretary of Tourism, as Chairman of the
Philippine Tourism Authority (PTA), shall exercise the functions of the PTA as
mandated by PD 564, Proclamation No. 1801, Letter of Instructions No. 1298,
Executive Order No. (EO) 6, EO 377 and Memorandum Order No. 214

Suspension of Building Permits. - Consistent with LOT 1298, the Mayor
of Malay shall suspend the issuance of building permits for any structure on
Boracay Island unless approved by the Chairman of the PTA and the Governor of
Aklan as Chairman of the klan Provincial Tourism Development Task Force.

Inter-Agency Committee, - The Inter-Agency Committee constituted by
LOI 1298 shall be reorganized as a full-time Task Force composed of responsible
personnel from the member agencies and headed in behalf of the Chairman of the
PTA by the Group Secretary of the Eminent Persons Group created by Executive

Group Secretary. - The Group Secretary shall have the rank and
emoluments of Undersecretary of Tourism.

All executive Issuances, orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18' day of January in the year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Eight.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
